answer: Because the timing is entered against the lotus challenge, the vine audit can replay the vertex history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 169 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3049 identities would post 4848 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
